stemEn: A kidney ultrasound picture was provided showing poor or absent corticomedullary differentiation, with the source uncertain whether the image represented ARPKD or ADPKD. Which of the following is correct regarding this diagnosis?

options.text: It is associated with kidney stones

explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يضع Correct answer: X ويصرح أنه لم يجد جوابًا، كما أن تحديد التشخيص من الصورة محفوظ بشكل غير مؤكد (?ARPKD or ADPKD). لذلك لا نعتمد أي إجابة، ولا يمكن نشر السؤال قبل استرجاع الصورة الأصلية والخيارات الناقصة.
reasoningEn: The source explicitly provides no correct answer and is uncertain whether the ultrasound represents ARPKD or ADPKD, so no answer should be inferred.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا يمكن تقييم خيار kidney stones أو بقية الخيارات بثقة لأن التشخيص والخيارات الأصلية غير مكتملة.
clinicalPearl: Do not infer a cystic-kidney diagnosis from an incomplete image description; imaging pattern, age, family history, liver findings and cyst distribution all matter.
diagnosticSteps: Recover and review the original ultrasound image

stemEn: A newborn presented with bilateral kidney masses and an X-ray was provided. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: المصدر يضع ARPKD بعلامة استفهام ويذكر أن X-ray ليست الطريقة المعتادة لتشخيص ARPKD، كما يشير إلى سؤال مشابه في PREP 2019 أجاب multicystic dysplastic kidney. لذلك نحفظ recalledAnswer=A لكن نضع السؤال conflicting حتى تُراجع الصورة الأصلية.
reasoningEn: The source tentatively keys ARPKD, but also flags the imaging modality as atypical and cites a similar question with a different diagnosis, creating a source-level conflict.
incorrectOptionsAr: Bilateral Wilms وbilateral neuroblastoma قد يسببان masses لكن لا يمكن ترجيحهما أو استبعادهما بدقة دون الصورة. المصدر لا يقدم تفسيرًا كافيًا يسمح بحسم السؤال من النص وحده.
clinicalPearl: ARPKD classically shows bilaterally enlarged echogenic kidneys with poor corticomedullary differentiation and tiny collecting-duct cysts on ultrasound.
diagnosticSteps: Recover and review the original image
Correlate with renal ultrasound and clinical context

stemEn: An adolescent known to have autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease presented with new-onset neurological symptoms. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: ADPKD يرتبط intracranial aneurysms؛ rupture قد يسبب subarachnoid hemorrhage مع acute severe neurological symptoms. لذلك المصدر يختار SAH.
reasoningEn: A ruptured intracranial aneurysm is a serious extra-renal complication of ADPKD and can present with subarachnoid hemorrhage.
incorrectOptionsAr: Brain abscess وbrain cyst ليستا الـclassic neurologic complication المرتبطة بـADPKD في هذا السؤال.
clinicalPearl: Sudden severe headache or acute neurologic symptoms in ADPKD should raise concern for intracranial aneurysm rupture.
managementSteps: Urgent neurologic evaluation and appropriate brain imaging for suspected SAH
